items.preText: Here's Romario Shepherd. Abhishek readies himself for just the second delivery he's going to face today
items.text: On a length just outside leg and shaping in, Abhishek looks to whip it away but misses
items.shortText: Shepherd to Abhishek Sharma, no run

items.text: Length ball around middle and leg, Abhishek drops it behind square on the off side and gets Samson back on strike

items.preText: Ashwath: "Wow 50 runs partnership and Abhishek on 1... how manybtime do we see this?" -- Very rare, this!
items.text: On a length around off, Samson hammers a drive down the ground but can't beat mid-off to his right
Crunched through extra cover for a 20-ball fifty! Samson raises his bat to great applause after Samson flat-bats this short ball outside off through the gap
Samson will accept that gift all day, every day! This is too full and too straight, and Samson doesn't have to do much as he just flicks it away through the vacant backward square region
Samson chases a wide, full delivery and ends up squeezing it into the midwicket region off the inside edge
items.postText: Vijay : "Samson 50  with Abhishek still on 2.. roles reversed?"

items.text: And that's curtains on the Sanju Samson show. Keemo Paul strikes first ball! Short ball on off angled across, and Samson looks to use the pace to pull it behind square. This time he doesn't quite get under it and it goes to Hetmyer in the deep. Hetmyer takes it above head-height before throwing it up in the air as momentum was taking him back. One foot lands behind the ropes, and he steadies himself before casually walking back in and completing the catch. Samson walks back having ensured India a perfect start in this mammoth chase!

dismissal.text: SV Samson c Hetmyer b Paul 56 (23b 6x4 4x6) SR: 243.47

items.preText: With Abhishek Sharma having faced just three balls, it's effectively two new batters at the crease! Ishan Kishan and Abhishek Sharma -- the SRH boys, in Hyderabad
items.text: Length ball angled across him, fended to cover
items.shortText: Paul to Ishan Kishan, no run

items.text: Bouncer on leg that Kishan tries to swivel and pull, but it goes over him. Called wide, but that was a well-directed short ball

items.preText: krishna kumar: "wonder how does hetmeyer takes catches cleanly all the time on the boundary. always cool as cucumber.!! "
items.text: Kishan picks the bones out of this slower ball! Off-cutter in the slot outside off and Kishan gives it a right thwack down the ground

Keemo Paul strikes back immediately! And that's a bit of a soft dismissal for Ishan Kishan! This is a 140kph slot ball on leg, and Kishan can't quite get under it as he looks to flick it away. Ends up hitting it straight to Jewel Andrew at deep midwicket. Paul leaps and punches the air. Two wickets in the over!

dismissal.text: Ishan Kishan c Andrew b Paul 6 (3b 0x4 1x6) SR: 200

items.preText: Shreyas Iyer joins Abhishek Sharma, who has opened the innings, faced just three balls and seen one half-century and two dismissals from the other end!
items.text: 137kph length ball wide of off, Iyer gets on his toes and punches it out to deep backward point
items.postText: We have The Don in today's MATCHUP. Who can you connect him with?

items.text: Back of length on leg, 137kph, Abhishek drops it down in front of square on the leg side and they get a single

items.preText: Shamar Springer will close out the powerplay
items.text: Abhishek tries to make something happen as he dances down the track. Springer goes short and across him and Abhishek tries to pull and just manages an under-edge into the midwicket area
Length ball on the pads, clips it to midwicket's right for a quick single
133kph bouncer on leg, Abhishek ducks and looks to pull but is beaten
items.shortText: Springer to Abhishek Sharma, no run

items.text: Oh, Abhishek manages to get in on the act! Not the most convincing of Abhishek Sharma shots, but he'll take the runs. This is very full on leg, but Abhishek backs away a long way and lofts it up inside out. Manages to clear the cover fielder running back and even with three fielders converging on the ball, they can't prevent the boundary
Springer again follows Abhishek as he backs away leg side. This time it's into the legs and Abhishek misses as he tries to flick it away. Goes to the off side off Abhishek's pads
items.shortText: Springer to Abhishek Sharma, 1 leg bye

items.text: Iyer ends the powerplay with a boundary. This is a slower ball on a length outside off and Iyer crunches it through the covers. India get to 80 at the end of the powerplay, one run more than West Indies at this stage
items.postText: Springer had said there's nothing much to do but be defensive against Abhishek. Looks like he's come up with a plan

items.text: Looks to flick and misses. Goes off the pads to the off side
items.shortText: Chase to Abhishek Sharma, no run

items.text: On a length around middle, clipped back to the bowler
items.shortText: Chase to Abhishek Sharma, no run

items.text: On a length around middle, Abhishek punches it out through point
Length ball outside off spins in, Iyer tucks it out to deep midwicket
On a length around leg, Abhishek rocks back and pulls it out to deep midwicket on the bounce
Length ball spins in from outside off, Iyer pushes it down towards long-on. He wanted two, but the fielder is quick to race in
